description: USGS Flood Event Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS, United States Geological Survey; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Explore hydrology and meteorology data related to specific flood events from 1888 through the present. This viewer is the public data discovery component of the USGS Short-Term Network (STN) database. Users can select a historical event such as a hurricane landfall and flood and examine data related to it. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, High Winds, Landslides. Assets: Economy, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
